card.name: Researcher first names before surnames
card.fires_on: First names or initials of researchers right after Dr. or in citation author lists, just before the surname. Also dashes and periods between citation items.

modes.label: Name after Dr.
modes.description: A researcher's first name right after Dr. in a news-style quote, with the surname next.
modes.example: Dr<< Aaron>> Cypess, who led the research

modes.label: Citation author names
modes.description: Initials, name pieces or separators inside reference lists before an author surname.
modes.example: Susanna C<<.>> Larsson of the Karolinska

card.writes: It promotes assorted unrelated tokens and suppresses disease words, so it pushes the model away from disease terms after a name.
card.plain: It fires on a researcher's first name just before the surname, mostly in quoted studies and reference lists.
